t: About Us – Kessler Sales & Distribution
s: In 1975, Bobby began shifting away from a traditional contractor-based supply house toward becoming a business-to-business master distributor. The company, then known as Kessler Industries, started reaching outside its core New Jersey market to serve wholesalers in New York, Pennsylvania and Connecticut, later expanding to cover the entire Boston to Baltimore corridor. From 1975 to 1994, Kessler systematically divested itself from contractor-direct sales and focused entirely on the wholesaler channel.
